records.title: I've tried other creams with better results...
records.body: Maybe I haven't used it long enough; I think I got it a few months back, but I didn't notice a single change in my scar. Mine isn't even a keloid scar. It's just a small port incision that got infected, so it's slightly raised and darker on one end, while the other end is hardly noticeable. I used a different advanced scar gel with faster results, initially. Maybe this stuff works, but it didn't for me.

records.title: Good for a project wig
records.body: I am a daily wig wearer and a long time cosplayer so I’ve had my fair share of wigs. This wig will be a hat wig unless you sew in some wefts to fill in the large gaps. You have to be extremely careful on how you part the hair or if the wind blows because you WILL see tracks. Once you sew more tracks in, it will be absolutely stunning.

aspects.opinion: The wig has visible gaps and tracks unless modified, but looks stunning after adding wefts.

actions.action: Improve coverage so tracks are not visible without sewing in additional wefts.

records.title: Buen bálsamo para la barba
records.body: Me enamore de este bálsamo para barba el otro día en la barbería a la que voy normalmente. Hasta el momento utilizaba aceite y (aparte que no tenía olor ninguno) daba la impresión que no tenía apenas efecto. Este bálsamo tiene un olor increíble, una textura muy buena y una vez que lo aplicas la barba queda bastante más manejable (para los que tenemos barba rizada es indispensable). La única pega que puedo darle es el método de embalaje, me llegó solo protegido por un trozo de cartón con fixo dentro de una bolsa, es por eso que no tiene 5 estrellas. Muy contento con la compra.
